messages:
Maya K: Quick handoff — I need to swap out with @Aj for the weekend oncall. Leaving some routing/threshold notes so we don't wake up unnecessarily.

Maya K: TL;DR: move model-runtime p50/p95 latency alerts to non-pager for sev3s, keep sev1/2 paging; raise Redis miss-rate threshold to 1.5% for the next 36h; route crunch/ooms to #eng-runtime only. I'll push config at 21:30 UTC.

Aj Patel: Got it. Can you paste the exact alert changes you want? I can apply and dry-run before 21:30.

Maya K: Sure — approx changes below, small ACL in alertmanager:

```yaml
route:
  receiver: 'team-default'
  group_by: ['alertname']
  routes:
    - match:
        team: 'runtime'
        alert_severity: 'sev3'
      receiver: 'runtime-digest'  # no pager, just channel
    - match_re:
        alertname: 'ModelOOM|ModelCrash'
      receiver: 'runtime-pager'
receivers:
  - name: 'runtime-pager'
    pagerduty_configs: []
  - name: 'runtime-digest'
    slack_configs:
      - channel: '#eng-runtime'
```

Maya K: And Redis miss-rate alert: set for 1.5% (was 1.0%) for next 36h, then revert. I added the revert job in ops-scripts; will trigger at 09:00 UTC Monday.

Aj Patel: That looks fine. I'll run `amtool check-config` then `amtool check-routing` in the staging cluster and paste results here.

pager-bot: Scheduled rotation update: Aj Patel -> weekend primary, Ryan Lee -> Sunday night 22:00-06:00 UTC fallback.

Ryan Lee: I'll be online Sunday night in case the autoscaler flaps. FYI I can take pages for infra if it escalates.

Maya K: Thanks — FYI the autoscaler has been flapping a bit after yesterday's deploy (spike in replica churn). If it spikes again, prioritize stabilizing scale settings before restarting any agents. The runbook is https://redwood.internal/runbooks/autoscaler-stabilize

Aj Patel: One more ask — can we route model-serving memory OOMs directly to #eng-runtime with pager for sev2+ ? We want humans involved quickly for OOMs.

Maya K: Agreed. Update the route for match_re 'ModelOOM' to runtime-pager for severity >= sev2. I'll let you modify and run the dry-run.

Aj Patel: Pushed PR to infra-config with the changes and a note to revert Redis threshold at Monday 09:00. Running `amtool` now, will report any issues.

Aj Patel: amtool OK, routing tests pass. Will deploy as a canary to staging then prod at 21:30 UTC; will monitor for 30m.

Maya K: :thumbsup: I'll be around 21:30->22:15 to watch PagerDuty heartbeat and logs. If anything unexpected, ping @infra-sre and escalate.

Ryan Lee: Noted. If I get woken, I'll follow autoscaler runbook first then contact infra-sre.

Aj Patel: Deployed to prod at 21:30 UTC. No immediate errors in the router logs.

Maya K: Saw the deploy, all good from my side. Leaving final note: keep model-runtime sev3s in digest for edge latency noise, but OOMs/crashes page. Redis threshold temporarily relaxed. Reverting job scheduled.

pager-bot: Rotation confirmed. Enjoy the weekend! :party_parrot:
